label: August 17–23, 2026
intro: BICT Fest opens Thursday August 21 — 11 participatory shows from 9 countries at One Bangkok. Catch Character Fest's final day Sunday Aug 17, hit the travel fair Wednesday, then dive into world-class children's theatre for the weekend.

activities.title: BICT Fest 2026 — Opening Weekend
activities.date: Thursday August 21 – Sunday August 23 (festival runs through Aug 30)
activities.time: Various show times — see bictfest.com/2026/ for full programme
activities.location: One Bangkok Park (primary) + Goethe-Institut Thailand + Sodsai Centre, Chulalongkorn Univ.
activities.price: Free programmes + ticketed shows via Eventpop
activities.why: 10th anniversary BICT Fest: 11 interactive performances by artists from 9 countries. Theme: 'Play Attention: Look Who's Growing Up!' Highlights include immersive light & shadow worlds (DuckUnit, Thailand) and Belgian circus artists who paint with their bodies (Plock!). Thor won't just watch — he'll be part of the action.
activities.tip: Book FREE programme slots at bictfest.com NOW — they go first. Opening weekend Thu–Sun has the most energy. Comfortable shoes — shows move between outdoor spaces at One Bangkok Park.

activities.title: Character Fest Thailand 2 — Final Day
activities.date: Sunday August 17 (closing day of the festival)
activities.location: CentralWorld, Level 1 – Beacon Zone, Central Court & Eden Zone (BTS Chit Lom)
activities.why: Last chance to catch Character Fest before it wraps. Pop culture characters, interactive experiences, and exclusive merchandise. Closing day has extra festive energy.
activities.tip: Arrive mid-morning before it gets crowded. Absolute final day — don't miss it.

activities.title: Thai Teaw Thai 79th — Domestic Travel Fair
activities.location: QSNCC, Exhibition Halls 5–6, LG Floor (MRT Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre, BL23)
activities.why: 800+ booths from Thailand's best resorts, hotels, and attractions — all offering exclusive deals. Great place to plan future Thor adventures (beach resort, waterpark, elephant sanctuary) and lock in cheap cool-season packages.
activities.tip: Thursday or Friday is less crowded than the weekend. Come with a wishlist of places you want to take Thor and hunt for the best package deals.

activities.title: ClassBento Kids Ceramic Workshop
activities.location: Multiple Bangkok studios (central BKK / Thonglor area)
activities.price: Check classbento.co.th for current session price
activities.why: Saturday morning pottery workshop + BICT Fest afternoon show = ultimate creative combo day. Thor makes something in the morning, then watches international theatre artists be creative all afternoon.
activities.tip: Book pottery first (fills faster), then slot in whichever BICT Fest show lines up with your afternoon time.
